_comment: Add this block to your Claude Code config (~/.claude.json on macOS). Replace ABS_PATH with the absolute path to your eui-embeddings checkout. Run `.venv-mcp/bin/python examples/mcp/server.py login` once first to sign in with your Elastic Google account. To use a local sidecar instead of the hosted API, add ICON_SEARCH_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4555 to env.
